name: unrealCrm
label: Unreal Engine (CRM)
doc: Unreal conventions with CRM packed (R cavity, G roughness, B metallic from the high's material): Unreal draws its own ambient occlusion, so cavity takes the packed occlusion channel to avoid doubling it. DirectX tangent normals in the MikkTSpace frame Unreal decodes, T_{material}_{suffix} names (M_ prefix dropped), UDIM tiles as .1001.
